observations: p01: port=8000; intended=allow; before=connect; during=connect; listener-during=true; drop-hits=0; after=connect.
p02: port=8001; intended=deny; before=connect; during=timeout; listener-during=true; drop-hits=3; after=connect.
limitations: Synthetic snapshots assume one client, fresh TCP attempts, no forwarding and counter deltas isolated to each attempted connection; packet counts need not equal connection counts.
A timeout alone does not identify a firewall. Export equality and restored connectivity support only this temporary-rule rollback, not the whole system's security.
